364
00:25:24,458 --> 00:25:26,260
<i>This allows us to monitor</i>
<i>your abilities,</i>

365
00:25:26,293 --> 00:25:28,629
<i>so that we don't touch</i>
<i>any part of your brain</i>

366
00:25:28,662 --> 00:25:30,998
<i>that might affect speech</i>
<i>or movement...</i>

367
00:25:34,902 --> 00:25:37,471
(SHAVER BUZZING)

368
00:25:37,506 --> 00:25:39,907
(EERIE MUSIC PLAYING)

369
00:25:48,883 --> 00:25:50,618
(DR. CORTEZ SPEAKING SPANISH)

370
00:25:52,486 --> 00:25:54,622
(INDISTINCT CONVERSATION)

371
00:25:54,655 --> 00:25:57,058
(BREATHING DEEPLY)

372
00:25:57,091 --> 00:25:59,093
(MONITOR BEEPING)

373
00:26:07,201 --> 00:26:08,636
DR. CORTEZ: Mr. Kramer...

374
00:26:08,669 --> 00:26:10,671
Can you please wiggle
your fingers?

375
00:26:11,472 --> 00:26:14,241
Good. Motor function is clear.

376
00:26:14,275 --> 00:26:15,609
Suction vac, please.

377
00:26:16,377 --> 00:26:17,912
(DR. CORTEZ SPEAKING SPANISH)

378
00:26:27,755 --> 00:26:29,890
(BREATHING DEEPLY)

379
00:26:45,139 --> 00:26:47,341
(IN ENGLISH) Valentina,
will you move...

380
00:26:49,443 --> 00:26:51,045
VALENTINA: Right, right, right.

381
00:26:57,718 --> 00:26:59,920
(EKG MACHINE BEEPING)

382
00:27:05,560 --> 00:27:08,796
MATEO: Okay, great.
We're gonna
put you back to sleep.

383
00:27:08,829 --> 00:27:11,198
I'm gonna count down from ten.

384
00:27:11,232 --> 00:27:12,233
Ten...

385
00:27:13,234 --> 00:27:15,736
nine, eight...

386
00:27:16,270 --> 00:27:18,873
<i>seven, six...</i>

387
00:27:26,581 --> 00:27:27,781
Hi, there.

388
00:27:29,483 --> 00:27:30,718
You did great.

389
00:27:31,752 --> 00:27:33,721
Where are we?

390
00:27:33,754 --> 00:27:36,390
We're two blocks away
from Mateo's hospital.

391
00:27:36,423 --> 00:27:38,192
In case you need a transfusion.

392
00:27:38,859 --> 00:27:40,194
I got your bloodwork.

393
00:27:45,132 --> 00:27:47,234
Hemoglobin's normal.

394
00:27:49,870 --> 00:27:51,372
It all looks good, John.

395
00:27:52,206 --> 00:27:53,407
It all looks good.

396
00:27:55,577 --> 00:27:56,777
Now...

397
00:27:57,546 --> 00:27:59,180
Drink two a day.

398
00:27:59,213 --> 00:28:01,248
One in the morning
and one at night.

399
00:28:01,282 --> 00:28:02,716
Okay.

400
00:28:02,750 --> 00:28:04,318
CECILIA: In addition
to my father's treatment,

401
00:28:04,351 --> 00:28:08,189
it contains a painkiller
you'll need for the next
seven days.

402
00:28:09,089 --> 00:28:10,991
And after that,
what happens then?

403
00:28:12,594 --> 00:28:14,295
Your whole life happens then.

404
00:28:14,862 --> 00:28:17,331
(BREATHES DEEPLY)

405
00:28:18,332 --> 00:28:20,301
(CHUCKLES SOFTLY)

406
00:28:20,334 --> 00:28:23,003
I never got a chance
to say goodbye to Gabriela.

407
00:28:23,672 --> 00:28:24,838
Or, any of the others.

408
00:28:24,872 --> 00:28:26,508
I'll send them your best.

409
00:28:26,541 --> 00:28:28,510
Don't get your head wet.

410
00:28:28,543 --> 00:28:29,944
The bandage is anti-bacterial.

411
00:28:29,977 --> 00:28:32,479
It will stave off infection.

412
00:28:32,514 --> 00:28:36,183
Valentina will swing by
to keep an eye on it for you.

413
00:28:36,217 --> 00:28:37,519
Get some rest now, John.

414
00:28:37,552 --> 00:28:38,752
Okay.

415
00:28:40,689 --> 00:28:42,856
Dr. Pederson,
just so you know...

416
00:28:42,890 --> 00:28:45,426
I'll wire the second half
of the payment tomorrow morning.

417
00:28:46,327 --> 00:28:47,328
Thank you, John.

418
00:28:48,896 --> 00:28:50,831
Have a good life, John.

419
00:28:52,266 --> 00:28:55,035
A long, good life.
(CHUCKLES SOFTLY)

420
00:29:00,675 --> 00:29:01,909
(SIGHS)

421
00:29:06,615 --> 00:29:08,782
(HOPEFUL INSTRUMENTAL MUSIC
PLAYING)

422
00:29:18,492 --> 00:29:20,461
(INDISTINCT CHATTER)

423
00:30:01,402 --> 00:30:03,170
Do you have a gift card?

424
00:30:03,203 --> 00:30:06,106
It's for a friend. Thank you.

425
00:30:19,186 --> 00:30:21,355
(HOPEFUL INSTRUMENTAL MUSIC
CONTINUES)

426
00:30:46,648 --> 00:30:48,849
<i>Un momento, por favor.</i>

427
00:30:50,918 --> 00:30:53,020
(GROANS SOFTLY)

428
00:31:01,462 --> 00:31:03,464
(SUSPENSEFUL MUSIC PLAYING)

429
00:31:05,899 --> 00:31:07,101
(IN ENGLISH) Hello?

430
00:31:10,904 --> 00:31:12,206
Gabriela?

431
00:31:33,862 --> 00:31:35,429
(FLIPS SWITCH)

432
00:31:43,505 --> 00:31:45,507
(TENSE MUSIC PLAYING)

433
00:32:24,445 --> 00:32:26,079
<i>Hello, and welcome</i>

434
00:32:26,113 --> 00:32:27,214
<i>to section five</i>

435
00:32:27,247 --> 00:32:29,149
<i>in our neurosurgery series.</i>

436
00:32:29,183 --> 00:32:32,554
<i>The human brain is a mystery,</i>
<i>hundreds of millions...</i>

437
00:32:36,457 --> 00:32:39,527
CECILIA: <i>We'll be performing</i>
<i>an "awake craniotomy."</i>

438
00:32:39,561 --> 00:32:43,230
<i>This means that you'll be</i>
<i>floating in and out</i>
<i>of consciousness.</i>

439
00:32:45,800 --> 00:32:47,034
DR. CORTEZ: Valentina...

440
00:32:47,067 --> 00:32:48,703
VALENTINA: Right, right, right.

441
00:32:53,741 --> 00:32:55,743
(TENSE MUSIC CONTINUES)

442
00:33:28,442 --> 00:33:30,110
CECILIA:
<i>Have a good life, John.</i>

443
00:33:30,143 --> 00:33:32,514
<i>A long, good life.</i>

444
00:33:32,547 --> 00:33:35,148
(CECILIA'S VOICE CONTINUES
DISTORTED)

445
00:33:40,020 --> 00:33:41,523
(JOHN SCREAMS)

446
00:33:47,060 --> 00:33:48,930
DIEGO: Hey, guys.

447
00:33:48,963 --> 00:33:53,333
Did you know that when
the Aztecs roll the heart
of their victim down the stairs

448
00:33:53,367 --> 00:33:57,037
people will take them home
and display them like ornaments?

449
00:33:57,070 --> 00:33:59,741
In their fucking houses.
Yeah. (CHUCKLES)

450
00:33:59,774 --> 00:34:03,511
TOURIST 1: Nice.
DIEGO: Yes, sir,
welcome to Mexico.

451
00:34:04,211 --> 00:34:07,782
Okay, so here we are.

452
00:34:08,983 --> 00:34:11,619
This is the Tlaloc statue.
Okay?

453
00:34:12,520 --> 00:34:14,923
Huh. Thank you, man.
Have a good one.

454
00:34:14,956 --> 00:34:16,390
TOURIST 2: Of course, man.
Thanks.

455
00:34:16,423 --> 00:34:18,425
(SIGHS)

456
00:34:18,458 --> 00:34:20,294
(SHUTS ENGINE)

457
00:34:20,327 --> 00:34:22,530
(PEOPLE TALKING INDISTINCTLY
IN SPANISH)

458
00:34:25,967 --> 00:34:27,167
Hello.

459
00:34:28,168 --> 00:34:29,369
<i>Buenas noches.</i>

460
00:34:32,172 --> 00:34:33,775
(JOHN SPEAKING)

461
00:34:33,808 --> 00:34:34,809
(DIEGO SCREAMS)

462
00:34:40,815 --> 00:34:42,082
(COUGHS, GROANS)

463
00:34:44,351 --> 00:34:46,153
(TENSE MUSIC PLAYING)

464
00:34:47,622 --> 00:34:49,624
(WHIMPERING)

465
00:34:51,659 --> 00:34:53,327
(CRYING)

466
00:34:55,830 --> 00:34:57,865
(SCREAMS IN SPANISH) <i>Ayuda!</i>

467
00:35:00,935 --> 00:35:03,103
<i>Ayuda!</i>

468
00:35:04,806 --> 00:35:06,273
(GROANS IN PAIN)

469
00:35:08,710 --> 00:35:09,711
Kramer?

470
00:35:10,778 --> 00:35:11,879
(IN ENGLISH) Hey, man.

471
00:35:12,981 --> 00:35:14,515
I've told you
what you wanted to know!

472
00:35:14,549 --> 00:35:16,918
I fucking told you
who you're looking for!

473
00:35:16,951 --> 00:35:17,986
(CURSES IN SPANISH)

474
00:35:18,019 --> 00:35:20,253
(PANTING)

475
00:35:21,355 --> 00:35:23,123
(SUSPENSEFUL MUSIC PLAYING)

476
00:35:23,156 --> 00:35:25,292
(PANTING)

477
00:35:25,693 --> 00:35:26,894
(GRUNTS)

478
00:35:37,872 --> 00:35:39,406
(MUTTERING)

479
00:35:40,742 --> 00:35:41,743
(SPEAKING SPANISH)

480
00:35:43,811 --> 00:35:45,880
Kramer. Kramer!

481
00:35:47,314 --> 00:35:48,916
(YELLING IN SPANISH)

482
00:35:50,084 --> 00:35:51,786
(BREATHING HEAVILY)

483
00:35:58,092 --> 00:36:01,428
JIGSAW: (ON TAPE)
<i>Hello, Diego.</i>
<i>Or, should I call you...</i>

484
00:36:02,597 --> 00:36:04,331
<i>Dr. Cortez?</i>

485
00:36:04,364 --> 00:36:06,934
<i>I'd like to play a game.</i>

486
00:36:06,968 --> 00:36:10,470
<i>Attached to your arms</i>
<i>are two explosive devices.</i>

487
00:36:11,304 --> 00:36:13,173
<i>Pipe bombs.</i>

488
00:36:13,206 --> 00:36:17,411
<i>Think of the explosives</i>
<i>as a sort of cancer.</i>

489
00:36:17,444 --> 00:36:22,416
<i>A malignancy that must be</i>
<i>cut out for you to survive.</i>

490
00:36:22,449 --> 00:36:26,154
<i>The blades cannot cut through</i>
<i>the galvanized cable.</i>

491
00:36:26,186 --> 00:36:29,624
<i>But they can slice through</i>
<i>flesh and muscle,</i>

492
00:36:29,657 --> 00:36:32,593
<i>allowing you to cut</i>
<i>the cancer away.</i>

493
00:36:32,627 --> 00:36:35,295
<i>Live, or die.</i>
<i>The choice is yours.</i>

494
00:36:35,328 --> 00:36:36,898
(TIMER BEEPS)

495
00:36:38,432 --> 00:36:40,802
No, no, no. No, no, no.

496
00:36:40,835 --> 00:36:42,335
-Kramer.
-(TIMER BEEPING)

497
00:36:42,737 --> 00:36:43,771
Kramer!

498
00:36:43,805 --> 00:36:45,773
Kramer!

499
00:36:45,807 --> 00:36:47,709
Kramer!

500
00:36:47,742 --> 00:36:50,410
(SPEAKING SPANISH)

501
00:36:54,549 --> 00:36:56,951
(PANTING)

502
00:36:59,153 --> 00:37:01,288
(MUTTERING)

503
00:37:11,065 --> 00:37:13,266
(TENSE MUSIC PLAYING)

504
00:37:33,721 --> 00:37:35,690
(TIMER BEEPING)

505
00:37:40,161 --> 00:37:41,763
(GRUNTING)

506
00:37:52,840 --> 00:37:54,509
(STRAINING)

507
00:38:02,950 --> 00:38:04,685
(EXCLAIMING IN PAIN)

508
00:38:07,354 --> 00:38:09,624
(TENSE MUSIC CONTINUES)

509
00:38:14,629 --> 00:38:15,897
(SCREAMS)

510
00:38:22,503 --> 00:38:23,971
(BREATHING HEAVILY)

511
00:38:30,511 --> 00:38:32,412
(GRIMACING IN PAIN)

512
00:38:35,616 --> 00:38:37,618
(CRYING)

513
00:38:44,457 --> 00:38:46,359
(SCREAMING IN PAIN)

514
00:39:08,182 --> 00:39:10,383
(CRYING)

515
00:39:28,102 --> 00:39:29,937
(GROANING)

516
00:39:36,010 --> 00:39:37,678
You're gonna be okay.

517
00:39:40,413 --> 00:39:41,549
<i>Detective...</i>

518
00:39:41,582 --> 00:39:44,085
I could use your assistance...

519
00:39:45,586 --> 00:39:50,858
in locating some people that are
in need of our services.

520
00:39:50,892 --> 00:39:52,894
(DANCE MUSIC PLAYING)

521
00:40:07,241 --> 00:40:09,176
(BOTH SPEAKING IN SPANISH)

522
00:40:12,079 --> 00:40:13,681
(VALENTINA CHUCKLES SENSUOUSLY)

523
00:40:16,284 --> 00:40:18,085
Okay. <i>Vamonos.</i>

524
00:40:23,858 --> 00:40:26,060
(SPEAKING SPANISH)

525
00:40:44,679 --> 00:40:45,680
(SCOFFS)

526
00:40:46,446 --> 00:40:49,617
-(SPEAKING SPANISH)
-(SCREAMS)

527
00:40:57,692 --> 00:41:00,061
-(SCREAMING)
-(GRUNTING)

528
00:41:09,270 --> 00:41:11,471
(PANTING)

529
00:41:15,876 --> 00:41:17,645
(WHIMPERS)

530
00:41:26,587 --> 00:41:28,456
(SCREAMING)

531
00:41:30,224 --> 00:41:32,226
(DOGS BARKING)

532
00:41:37,898 --> 00:41:39,000
(DOOR CLOSES)

533
00:41:42,536 --> 00:41:43,738
(SPEAKING IN SPANISH)

534
00:41:48,709 --> 00:41:49,910
(SPEAKING SPANISH)

535
00:42:08,129 --> 00:42:09,130
Mateo?

536
00:42:14,435 --> 00:42:15,636
(IN ENGLISH) Hey.

537
00:42:17,605 --> 00:42:19,607
(SPEAKING SPANISH)

538
00:42:22,343 --> 00:42:23,744
GABRIELA: Mm.

539
00:42:33,954 --> 00:42:34,955
<i>Gracias.</i>

540
00:42:39,593 --> 00:42:40,761
(DOGS WHIMPERING)

541
00:42:40,795 --> 00:42:42,229
(DOGS STOP BARKING)

542
00:42:42,263 --> 00:42:43,664
(SIGHS)

543
00:43:08,689 --> 00:43:10,658
-(ELECTRICITY CRACKLING)
-(SCREAMING)

544
00:43:13,260 --> 00:43:15,262
(DANCE MUSIC PLAYING DISTANTLY)

545
00:43:28,042 --> 00:43:29,743
(DOOR SQUEAKING)

546
00:43:32,480 --> 00:43:34,048
(TOILET FLUSHING)

547
00:43:39,386 --> 00:43:40,988
(WATER RUNNING)

548
00:44:01,208 --> 00:44:02,376
(FOOTSTEPS APPROACHING)

549
00:44:11,520 --> 00:44:12,887
(SPEAKING SPANISH)

550
00:44:19,059 --> 00:44:20,995
(ITEMS CLINKING)

551
00:44:23,632 --> 00:44:25,332
(GABRIELA BREATHING HEAVILY)

552
00:44:29,770 --> 00:44:31,338
(DOOR CREAKING)

553
00:44:39,146 --> 00:44:40,881
(GRUNTS)

554
00:44:43,518 --> 00:44:44,919
(GROANING)

555
00:44:46,020 --> 00:44:48,222
-(SCREAMING)
-(SPRAYING)

556
00:44:51,759 --> 00:44:55,664
CECILIA: I'm arranging
a small team in Bolivia
next week, Margaret.

557
00:44:55,696 --> 00:44:58,933
Yeah, we have three cases
scheduled already.

558
00:44:58,966 --> 00:45:02,102
But I think that we might
have room for one more spot.

559
00:45:02,136 --> 00:45:04,104
Yeah. We're working
off the grid, of course,

560
00:45:04,138 --> 00:45:07,308
but if you think
you can get there, Margaret.

561
00:45:09,678 --> 00:45:13,280
No... Please,
no need to cry, Margaret.

562
00:45:14,649 --> 00:45:17,619
No... (CHUCKLES)
I'm not an angel.

563
00:45:17,652 --> 00:45:19,186
It's pure science.

564
00:45:20,254 --> 00:45:22,389
All right.

565
00:45:22,423 --> 00:45:25,960
You send those medical records
in and we'll have a look,
all right?

566
00:45:26,628 --> 00:45:27,828
Perfect.

567
00:45:28,762 --> 00:45:30,064
See you soon, Margaret.

568
00:45:30,632 --> 00:45:31,832
See you soon.

569
00:45:32,534 --> 00:45:33,734
(CELL PHONE BEEPS)

570
00:45:38,339 --> 00:45:39,873
(DISTANT THUDDING)

571
00:45:40,908 --> 00:45:43,444
(RADIO ANNOUNCER
SPEAKING IN FRENCH)

572
00:45:47,649 --> 00:45:49,016
(DISTANT THUDDING)

573
00:46:49,810 --> 00:46:51,111
I've got a gun!

574
00:47:25,346 --> 00:47:27,716
-(GLASS SHATTERING)
-(SCREAMING)

575
00:47:27,749 --> 00:47:29,784
(BREATHING HEAVILY)

576
00:47:29,818 --> 00:47:32,019
(TENSE MUSIC PLAYING)

577
00:47:44,498 --> 00:47:46,100
(GARAGE DOOR OPENING)

578
00:47:46,768 --> 00:47:48,268
(CAR STARTING)

579
00:47:50,471 --> 00:47:51,972
What the fuck...

580
00:47:54,642 --> 00:47:55,643
(GASPS)

581
00:48:11,158 --> 00:48:12,159
Hi.

582
00:48:14,228 --> 00:48:15,396
Who are you?

583
00:48:16,531 --> 00:48:18,700
This is my associate, Amanda.

584
00:48:18,733 --> 00:48:20,501
(VALENTINA SCREAMING)

585
00:48:22,102 --> 00:48:23,638
-(GRUNTS)
-(YELPS)

586
00:48:24,405 --> 00:48:26,574
-(ELECTRICITY CRACKLING)
-(SCREAMS)

587
00:48:30,944 --> 00:48:32,647
(GRUNTING)

588
00:48:36,417 --> 00:48:38,520
Get some rest, Cecilia.

589
00:48:39,754 --> 00:48:42,122
You're going to
fucking need it.

590
00:48:45,926 --> 00:48:48,128
-(MAN SCREAMING)
-(CHAIN CLANGING)

591
00:48:52,667 --> 00:48:53,868
Mateo.

592
00:48:53,902 --> 00:48:56,003
(GRUNTS) What the fuck
is going on?

593
00:48:56,036 --> 00:48:57,705
(SCREAMING)
Why are we back here?

594
00:48:58,873 --> 00:49:01,275
Oh, my God. What the...

595
00:49:01,308 --> 00:49:03,912
-(MATEO CONTINUES SCREAMING)
-(CHAINS CLANKING)

596
00:49:03,944 --> 00:49:05,379
(GROANS)

597
00:49:07,549 --> 00:49:10,951
MATEO: Oh, my God. Oh, my God.
Help. Who are you?

598
00:49:10,984 --> 00:49:14,087
-Do you know why we're here?
-Hey! Hey.

599
00:49:14,121 --> 00:49:16,390
-MATEO: Lady, do you know...
-(GABRIELA SPEAKS IN SPANISH)

600
00:49:16,423 --> 00:49:17,692
Do you know who
brought us here?

601
00:49:17,725 --> 00:49:19,026
(VALENTINA SPEAKING IN SPANISH)

602
00:49:19,059 --> 00:49:21,395
MATEO: (IN ENGLISH)
Hey! Can you help us?

603
00:49:21,428 --> 00:49:22,429
(GROANS)

604
00:49:27,301 --> 00:49:30,538
Who are you?
Please. Please, please.

605
00:49:30,572 --> 00:49:32,473
-(GROANING)
-Hey, hey...

606
00:49:39,881 --> 00:49:41,448
What... What are you doing?

607
00:49:41,950 --> 00:49:44,117
(RATTLING)

608
00:49:47,087 --> 00:49:48,322
GABRIELA: Hey.

609
00:49:48,923 --> 00:49:50,123
(DOOR SLAMS)

610
00:49:53,227 --> 00:49:54,228
John?

611
00:49:55,395 --> 00:49:56,598
It was you?

612
00:49:57,464 --> 00:49:58,700
(SCREAMING) Why?

613
00:49:59,834 --> 00:50:01,268
Why are we here?

614
00:50:02,637 --> 00:50:03,638
CECILIA: John!

615
00:50:04,506 --> 00:50:06,206
What is this?

616
00:50:06,240 --> 00:50:08,475
We were only trying
to help you.

617
00:50:09,744 --> 00:50:11,345
That game is over.

618
00:50:11,378 --> 00:50:13,480
And a new game is
about to begin.

619
00:50:16,851 --> 00:50:18,352
-Valentina...
-(WHIMPERING)

620
00:50:18,385 --> 00:50:20,522
...did my blood ever
make it to the lab?

621
00:50:21,288 --> 00:50:22,657
<i>Or...</i>

622
00:50:22,690 --> 00:50:25,760
did you just suck it out
and flush it down
the drain somewhere?

623
00:50:26,460 --> 00:50:27,695
(WHIMPERING)

624
00:50:27,729 --> 00:50:29,396
MATEO: Mr. Kramer. Mr. Kramer.

625
00:50:29,429 --> 00:50:31,331
Please, listen to me.
I beg you.

626
00:50:31,365 --> 00:50:33,500
I beg you, please. Please.

627
00:50:34,769 --> 00:50:36,270
We have nothing
to do with this.

628
00:50:36,303 --> 00:50:38,305
We didn't know what was
going on. It was all her.

629
00:50:38,338 --> 00:50:40,274
She planned the whole thing.

630
00:50:40,307 --> 00:50:44,478
Mateo, I don't even know
if that's your real name.

631
00:50:44,512 --> 00:50:47,381
-It is my real name.
-It is, oh.

632
00:50:48,716 --> 00:50:52,252
'Cause they have never heard
of you at the hospital.

633
00:50:52,286 --> 00:50:53,888
She told me to say that
I worked there.

634
00:50:53,922 --> 00:50:56,624
-But I don't. I'm sorry.
-JOHN: Mm, mm.

635
00:50:56,658 --> 00:50:59,527
-MATEO: Please wait.
Let me explain.
-Mr. Kramer...

636
00:51:02,195 --> 00:51:04,498
I meant no harm.

637
00:51:04,532 --> 00:51:08,803
I would really like
to believe you, Gabriela.

638
00:51:08,836 --> 00:51:11,138
(SOBBING)

639
00:51:11,171 --> 00:51:13,273
You'll have a chance
to prove yourself.

640
00:51:14,676 --> 00:51:17,545
<i>Por favor. Por favor.</i>

641
00:51:19,313 --> 00:51:21,114
(WHIMPERING QUIETLY)

642
00:51:29,256 --> 00:51:32,092
The key to your freedom
is inside that box.

643
00:51:36,096 --> 00:51:37,599
What the hell is that?

644
00:51:37,632 --> 00:51:39,567
It's a Gigli saw.

645
00:51:40,969 --> 00:51:42,737
I thought you said
there was a key?

646
00:51:42,770 --> 00:51:44,806
He was speaking metaphorically.

647
00:51:44,839 --> 00:51:46,674
He does that a lot.

648
00:51:48,042 --> 00:51:50,110
When I get out of here,

649
00:51:50,143 --> 00:51:53,380
I'm gonna kill both of you
motherfuckers!

650
00:51:55,984 --> 00:51:57,552
That's a good plan.

651
00:51:57,585 --> 00:51:59,954
You're gonna wanna
really listen carefully

652
00:51:59,988 --> 00:52:02,322
to the rules
in order to pull that off.

653
00:52:03,290 --> 00:52:05,292
Fuck you! (SCREAMS)

654
00:52:10,230 --> 00:52:12,199
-(WHIMPERING)
-(MACHINE WHIRRING)

655
00:52:13,701 --> 00:52:14,736
Go ahead.

656
00:52:15,670 --> 00:52:17,772
No. No.

657
00:52:17,805 --> 00:52:18,806
What...

658
00:52:22,476 --> 00:52:24,679
-(MACHINE POWERING UP)
-No. No. What?

659
00:52:28,482 --> 00:52:30,985
The wire saw inside of that box

660
00:52:31,019 --> 00:52:33,487
was invented
by an Italian physician.

661
00:52:33,521 --> 00:52:36,223
Leonardo Gigli.

662
00:52:36,256 --> 00:52:39,527
It creates an extraordinarily
clean-cut to the bone.

663
00:52:39,560 --> 00:52:40,862
No.

664
00:52:44,966 --> 00:52:46,134
(SAW WHIRRING)

665
00:52:46,166 --> 00:52:48,102
No. No, no, no, no, no!

666
00:52:48,136 --> 00:52:49,737
No, no, no, no!

667
00:52:49,771 --> 00:52:51,906
(SCREAMS)

668
00:52:55,576 --> 00:52:57,277
(SOBBING)

669
00:52:59,747 --> 00:53:02,550
The dotted line on your leg
marks the spot.

670
00:53:03,818 --> 00:53:06,219
Are you fucking crazy?

671
00:53:06,253 --> 00:53:08,956
What makes you think
I'd fucking cut off my own leg?

672
00:53:10,424 --> 00:53:12,325
JOHN: Because if you don't,

673
00:53:12,359 --> 00:53:15,362
the wire saw that's wrapped
around your neck

674
00:53:16,164 --> 00:53:17,899
will first cut into your skin,

675
00:53:17,932 --> 00:53:20,034
then your vertebral ligaments,

676
00:53:20,068 --> 00:53:22,436
and finally, it'll sever
your spinal cord.

677
00:53:22,469 --> 00:53:24,204
VALENTINA: (WHIMPERING) No.

678
00:53:24,237 --> 00:53:26,473
The CliffsNotes version?

679
00:53:27,474 --> 00:53:29,309
(WHISPERING) It's gonna
cut your head off.

680
00:53:31,411 --> 00:53:32,412
No!

681
00:53:33,815 --> 00:53:34,849
CECILIA: You won't.

682
00:53:34,882 --> 00:53:36,751
You wouldn't.

683
00:53:36,784 --> 00:53:37,985
Uh, it's true.

684
00:53:38,686 --> 00:53:39,687
We won't.

685
00:53:42,289 --> 00:53:43,658
But Valentina might.

686
00:53:43,691 --> 00:53:46,027
(SHUDDERS)

687
00:53:46,060 --> 00:53:47,360
JOHN: All of you...

688
00:53:51,032 --> 00:53:52,332
All of you...

689
00:53:53,901 --> 00:53:54,969
All of you...

690
00:53:58,539 --> 00:54:01,008
You promised dying people.

691
00:54:02,110 --> 00:54:03,845
Dying people!

692
00:54:07,347 --> 00:54:08,816
That you could save their lives.

693
00:54:08,850 --> 00:54:13,921
And in doing so, you took
advantage of the only thing...

694
00:54:16,591 --> 00:54:18,325
that they still possessed.

695
00:54:21,863 --> 00:54:23,497
Hope.

696
00:54:23,531 --> 00:54:26,734
No, John. We've worked
to heal people.

697
00:54:28,202 --> 00:54:31,906
Your case was... different.

698
00:54:31,939 --> 00:54:32,974
(SCOFFS)

699
00:54:33,440 --> 00:54:35,910
And still you lie.

700
00:54:35,943 --> 00:54:39,647
My associate, Amanda here,
has had a look
at your bank records.

701
00:54:41,348 --> 00:54:42,650
Take a look.

702
00:54:46,087 --> 00:54:48,288
Who are those 34 people to you?

703
00:54:48,321 --> 00:54:50,423
AMANDA: John's case
was different?

704
00:54:50,457 --> 00:54:53,628
Did you heal
any of those 34 people?

705
00:54:53,661 --> 00:54:56,329
JOHN: Did they have children
that are now orphaned?

706
00:54:56,363 --> 00:54:58,900
You've been doing this
larcenist dance now

707
00:54:58,933 --> 00:55:00,635
for more than eight years.

708
00:55:00,668 --> 00:55:02,469
Eight years.

709
00:55:02,502 --> 00:55:04,605
That's more than $8 million.

710
00:55:06,107 --> 00:55:07,474
That's a lot of pain...

711
00:55:07,508 --> 00:55:09,710
to inflict on others

712
00:55:10,978 --> 00:55:12,814
for your own enrichment.

713
00:55:12,847 --> 00:55:16,083
AMANDA: There was no healing
going on there, bitch.

714
00:55:16,117 --> 00:55:18,786
They're all underground.
I checked.

715
00:55:18,820 --> 00:55:20,888
We know everything.

716
00:55:20,922 --> 00:55:22,723
We have everything.

717
00:55:22,757 --> 00:55:25,793
Including the cash
from your house.

718
00:55:25,827 --> 00:55:27,695
We have it upstairs.

719
00:55:30,298 --> 00:55:32,567
Please. Please,
don't do this. Please.

720
00:55:32,600 --> 00:55:34,268
(CRYING) Please, help me.

721
00:55:34,302 --> 00:55:35,636
Please.

722
00:55:35,670 --> 00:55:38,039
JOHN: That's exactly
what we are doing, Valentina.

723
00:55:38,873 --> 00:55:40,373
This is not retribution,

724
00:55:42,109 --> 00:55:43,744
it's a reawakening.

725
00:55:43,778 --> 00:55:45,378
(SOBBING)

726
00:55:47,815 --> 00:55:51,586
Valentina, follow
my instructions
if you want to live.

727
00:55:51,619 --> 00:55:54,989
There are more than five pounds
of marrow in the human body.

728
00:55:55,022 --> 00:55:56,423
All you need is three ounces.

729
00:55:56,456 --> 00:55:59,293
-(SCOFFS)
-There's more than
enough in your femur.

730
00:55:59,327 --> 00:56:00,595
Just suction it out,

731
00:56:00,628 --> 00:56:03,831
it'll be transferred
to that device right there

732
00:56:03,865 --> 00:56:07,101
and it will deactivate the saw
around your neck.

733
00:56:07,134 --> 00:56:08,501
Don't hesitate.

734
00:56:08,536 --> 00:56:10,638
Because your time is
prescribed.

735
00:56:10,671 --> 00:56:11,839
(SOBBING)

736
00:56:13,507 --> 00:56:16,277
(CRYING) No. No.

737
00:56:16,310 --> 00:56:18,246
JOHN: Now,
refusing to play the game

738
00:56:18,279 --> 00:56:20,147
is not an option.

739
00:56:20,181 --> 00:56:21,481
If you refuse...

740
00:56:21,515 --> 00:56:23,284
you will remain in this room...

741
00:56:23,317 --> 00:56:24,752
(SOBBING)

742
00:56:25,219 --> 00:56:26,419
Forever.

743
00:56:28,322 --> 00:56:30,157
(WHISPERS) You'll make it.

744
00:56:30,191 --> 00:56:31,792
So long as you keep your head.

745
00:56:33,094 --> 00:56:35,229
MATEO: We were not involved
in the whole thing.

746
00:56:35,263 --> 00:56:36,463
(GABRIELA SPEAKING IN SPANISH)

747
00:56:36,496 --> 00:56:38,699
-MATEO: (IN ENGLISH) Please.
-John! Please.

748
00:56:41,369 --> 00:56:43,137
This is not right.

749
00:56:43,170 --> 00:56:44,505
Not right?

750
00:56:46,707 --> 00:56:48,876
A lecture in moral decency?

751
00:56:50,011 --> 00:56:51,045
From you?

752
00:56:54,282 --> 00:56:55,917
MATEO: No, no, John. John!

753
00:56:55,950 --> 00:56:58,418
-(VALENTINA WHIMPERING)
-Please, wait, John!

754
00:56:59,120 --> 00:57:00,121
John!

755
00:57:00,888 --> 00:57:02,056
John!

756
00:57:02,089 --> 00:57:04,025
Please, please, please, help me.

757
00:57:04,058 --> 00:57:06,093
(ALL CLAMORING)

758
00:57:08,495 --> 00:57:09,730
-MATEO: John, please wait!
-(JOHN COUGHING)

759
00:57:09,764 --> 00:57:11,132
Please wait! Please wait!

760
00:57:13,301 --> 00:57:15,002
(DOOR CLOSES)

761
00:57:16,103 --> 00:57:18,205
(MATEO AND GABRIELA CRYING)

762
00:57:21,075 --> 00:57:22,710
GABRIELA: <i>What do we do?</i>

763
00:57:22,743 --> 00:57:24,946
(GABRIELA SPEAKING IN SPANISH)

764
00:57:27,515 --> 00:57:29,717
(CHAINS CLANKING AND THUDDING)

765
00:57:34,989 --> 00:57:36,424
John!

766
00:57:36,456 --> 00:57:40,861
MATEO: John, please wait!
You don't have to do this!
John! John!

767
00:57:41,862 --> 00:57:43,230
No, no.

768
00:57:43,264 --> 00:57:44,765
Valentina, look at me.

769
00:57:44,799 --> 00:57:45,800
Look at me!

770
00:57:46,334 --> 00:57:47,500
You can do this.

771
00:57:47,535 --> 00:57:49,370
No, no, no, I can't! No.

772
00:57:49,403 --> 00:57:50,905
You have to do this!

773
00:57:50,938 --> 00:57:52,106
No!

774
00:57:52,139 --> 00:57:53,274
(SPEAKS IN SPANISH)

775
00:57:53,307 --> 00:57:55,843
(IN ENGLISH) Valentina,
come on! Do it!

776
00:57:56,744 --> 00:57:57,812
Okay.

777
00:57:58,546 --> 00:58:00,648
(VALENTINA WHIMPERING ON CAMERA)

778
00:58:04,986 --> 00:58:06,253
MATEO: You can do it.

779
00:58:08,856 --> 00:58:10,458
(TIMER BEEPING)

780
00:58:10,524 --> 00:58:12,093
Oh, my God! No!

781
00:58:13,761 --> 00:58:15,429
(TENSE MUSIC PLAYING)

782
00:58:15,463 --> 00:58:17,631
No, no, no, no, no! No, no, no!

783
00:58:18,532 --> 00:58:19,867
Oh, my God.

784
00:58:19,900 --> 00:58:20,868
(SPEAKS SPANISH)

785
00:58:20,901 --> 00:58:22,636
-(IN ENGLISH) The tourniquet.
-No, no!

786
00:58:22,670 --> 00:58:23,704
CECILIA: Put it on.

787
00:58:23,738 --> 00:58:25,139
Goddamn it! Valentina.

788
00:58:25,172 --> 00:58:26,774
The tourniquet, put it on!

789
00:58:27,775 --> 00:58:29,276
Faster!

790
00:58:29,310 --> 00:58:30,911
(WHIMPERING)

791
00:58:33,280 --> 00:58:34,482
You can do this.

792
00:58:34,515 --> 00:58:36,784
-You can do this!
-(SOBBING)

793
00:58:37,618 --> 00:58:38,886
Now, the wire saw.

794
00:58:40,221 --> 00:58:41,522
Wrap it under your leg.

795
00:58:42,990 --> 00:58:45,760
MATEO: If Diego could do this,
you can do this.

796
00:58:46,761 --> 00:58:47,762
Okay.

797
00:58:48,863 --> 00:58:51,298
-(BREATH TREMBLING)
-CECILIA: Come on.

798
00:58:51,332 --> 00:58:54,168
You have to. Save yourself!

799
00:58:54,201 --> 00:58:56,904
-(FLESH TEARS)
-(SCREAMING)

800
00:58:57,972 --> 00:58:59,607
Oh, my God!

801
00:58:59,640 --> 00:59:01,308
-(SCREAMING)
-(CRYING)

802
00:59:01,342 --> 00:59:02,810
(WHIMPERING LOUDLY)

803
00:59:08,649 --> 00:59:10,985
I can't! I can't!

804
00:59:11,018 --> 00:59:13,087
Don't stop, don't think!
Just do it!

805
00:59:13,120 --> 00:59:14,588
(SCREAMING) No!

806
00:59:15,890 --> 00:59:17,625
-(FLESH TEARS)
-(SCREAMING)

807
00:59:23,030 --> 00:59:24,533
Come on!

808
00:59:24,565 --> 00:59:26,634
-Faster.
-(SCREAMING)

809
00:59:29,003 --> 00:59:32,873
Do it, don't think. Keep going.
You're gonna die. Come on!

810
00:59:32,907 --> 00:59:35,342
(SCREAMING)

811
00:59:35,376 --> 00:59:37,344
CECILIA: You're running
out of time!

812
00:59:37,378 --> 00:59:38,646
Come on.

813
00:59:39,246 --> 00:59:40,347
Fuck. Come on!

814
00:59:41,449 --> 00:59:42,950
Faster.

815
00:59:42,983 --> 00:59:46,120
Come on. Faster!
Keep going until it's off!

816
00:59:46,153 --> 00:59:47,988
(SCREAMING) No!

817
00:59:53,127 --> 00:59:54,962
(BREATHING HEAVILY)

818
00:59:54,995 --> 00:59:56,197
(BEEPING)

819
00:59:56,230 --> 00:59:58,899
For God's sake, Valentina,
save yourself!

820
00:59:58,933 --> 01:00:00,835
(GRUNTING)

821
01:00:04,338 --> 01:00:05,973
(SCREAMS)

822
01:00:07,542 --> 01:00:08,909
(WHIMPERING)

823
01:00:11,112 --> 01:00:12,680
(BREATHING HEAVILY)

824
01:00:12,713 --> 01:00:14,315
(TIMER BEEPING)

825
01:00:18,285 --> 01:00:19,320
Go on.

826
01:00:24,492 --> 01:00:26,927
Okay, okay, okay.

827
01:00:26,961 --> 01:00:29,763
-CECILIA: You're running
out of time!
-(VALENTINA GRUNTING)

828
01:00:30,798 --> 01:00:32,633
Come on, come on,
come on, come on!

829
01:00:32,666 --> 01:00:33,834
MATEO: You're doing great.

830
01:00:33,868 --> 01:00:35,769
-You're doing great.
-(GRUNTING IN PAIN)

831
01:00:37,238 --> 01:00:38,772
(SCREAMING HOARSELY)

832
01:00:44,579 --> 01:00:46,247
(SUSPENSEFUL MUSIC PLAYING)

833
01:00:55,956 --> 01:00:57,124
Please.

834
01:01:09,136 --> 01:01:11,138
VALENTINA:
I'm not gonna make it.

835
01:01:11,172 --> 01:01:12,806
No, no, no! I'm no
going to make it!

836
01:01:12,840 --> 01:01:15,442
-Oh, my God. No. No. No.
-(TIMER BEEPING)

837
01:01:15,476 --> 01:01:17,878
No, no, no, no!

838
01:01:18,712 --> 01:01:20,047
No, no, no, no!

839

1089
01:17:40,394 --> 01:17:41,829
I don't know how to do this.

1090
01:17:41,862 --> 01:17:43,731
-I don't know how to do that.
-(COLLAR BUZZING)

1091
01:17:43,764 --> 01:17:46,167
(SCREAMING)

1092
01:17:46,200 --> 01:17:49,069
(PANTING) Okay...

1093
01:17:49,103 --> 01:17:53,374
JIGSAW: <i>The only thing</i>
<i>I have not provided</i>
<i>is your anesthetic.</i>

1094
01:17:53,407 --> 01:17:58,012
<i>But trust me,</i>
<i>you will want to remain alert.</i>

1095
01:17:58,679 --> 01:18:00,314
<i>And if you fail to act,</i>

1096
01:18:00,347 --> 01:18:04,251
<i>the consequences</i>
<i>will not go well for you.</i>

1097
01:18:04,285 --> 01:18:07,087
<i>Do not waste time.</i>

1098
01:18:07,121 --> 01:18:10,559
<i>Live or die,</i>
<i>the choice is yours.</i>

1099
01:18:10,592 --> 01:18:12,893
(TIMER BEEPING)

1100
01:18:16,030 --> 01:18:17,031
No, no, no.

1101
01:18:17,998 --> 01:18:20,134
I need to take this thing off.

1102
01:18:20,167 --> 01:18:22,002
(SCREAMING)

1103
01:18:23,605 --> 01:18:25,072
-Somebody help me.
-Mateo.

1104
01:18:25,105 --> 01:18:27,474
What do I do? What do I do?
What do I do?

1105
01:18:27,509 --> 01:18:28,909
You have to use the craniotome.

1106
01:18:28,943 --> 01:18:30,778
(GABRIELA SPEAKING SPANISH)

1107
01:18:30,811 --> 01:18:32,647
CECILIA: (IN ENGLISH)
Yes, Mateo, you have to.

1108
01:18:32,681 --> 01:18:34,882
That is not going to
fucking happen.

1109
01:18:34,915 --> 01:18:36,518
You have to cut into your scalp.

1110
01:18:36,551 --> 01:18:38,319
-No. No.
-Yes!

1111
01:18:38,352 --> 01:18:39,286
(SPEAKS SPANISH)

1112
01:18:39,320 --> 01:18:40,788
(IN ENGLISH) I can't do it.
I can't...

1113
01:18:40,821 --> 01:18:43,324
Do you want to live?
Or wind up like her?

1114
01:18:46,193 --> 01:18:47,895
-Mateo!
-Okay.

1115
01:18:52,399 --> 01:18:53,434
Is there a cable?

1116
01:18:54,703 --> 01:18:56,470
MATEO: Is this it?

1117
01:18:56,503 --> 01:18:57,771
This is it.

1118
01:18:57,805 --> 01:18:59,206
Yes. (SPEAKING SPANISH)

1119
01:19:02,711 --> 01:19:04,945
(DRILL WHIRRING)

1120
01:19:07,649 --> 01:19:10,784
-(BREATHING HEAVILY)
-CECILIA: Just do it.

1121
01:19:15,690 --> 01:19:17,659
(SCREAMING)

1122
01:19:17,692 --> 01:19:18,959
(BREATHING HEAVILY)

1123
01:19:20,261 --> 01:19:21,762
(TIMER BEEPING)

1124
01:19:27,134 --> 01:19:28,435
(DRILL WHIRS)

1125
01:19:28,469 --> 01:19:30,004
(SCREAMING)

1126
01:19:40,848 --> 01:19:43,050
(TISSUE SQUISHES)

1127
01:19:47,888 --> 01:19:50,024
(SCREAMING)

1128
01:19:57,331 --> 01:19:58,499
(GABRIELA WHIMPERING)

1129
01:20:00,301 --> 01:20:01,902
(PANTING)

1130
01:20:12,112 --> 01:20:14,148
(GRUNTING)

1131
01:20:17,619 --> 01:20:18,753
Faster!

1132
01:20:18,787 --> 01:20:20,454
(SCREAMING)

1133
01:20:29,396 --> 01:20:30,598
(GAGS)

1134
01:20:30,632 --> 01:20:32,866
(PANTING)

1135
01:20:37,871 --> 01:20:40,274
Oh, my God. Oh... Oh, my God.

1136
01:20:40,307 --> 01:20:42,176
(TISSUE SQUISHES)

1137
01:20:45,513 --> 01:20:48,148
(SCREAMING)

1138
01:20:48,182 --> 01:20:49,584
Pull it out!

1139
01:20:49,617 --> 01:20:51,185
(BEEPING)

1140
01:20:52,687 --> 01:20:54,689
Ah! (GRUNTING)

1141
01:20:54,723 --> 01:20:56,624
Dig it out! Do it!

1142
01:21:15,309 --> 01:21:16,310
Oh...

1143
01:21:24,084 --> 01:21:26,654
GABRIELA: No! (SPEAKING SPANISH)

1144
01:21:34,027 --> 01:21:36,130
(SCREAMING)

1145
01:21:36,798 --> 01:21:38,432
-(MUFFLED SCREAMING)
-No!

1146
01:21:46,641 --> 01:21:49,009
No! Mateo!

1147
01:21:56,551 --> 01:21:57,951
(GABRIELA SOBBING)

1148
01:21:57,985 --> 01:21:59,486
(GABRIELA SOBBING SOFTLY)

1149
01:22:01,922 --> 01:22:03,658
You guys are fucking sick.

1150
01:22:04,526 --> 01:22:06,193
JOHN: We're sick?

1151
01:22:06,226 --> 01:22:09,163
These people kill
with false hope.

1152
01:22:15,068 --> 01:22:16,604
(SIGHS SOFTLY)

1153
01:22:25,580 --> 01:22:29,049
AMANDA: What if there is
something her father
can do to help you?

1154
01:22:29,717 --> 01:22:31,686
Amanda, you know

1155
01:22:31,719 --> 01:22:33,086
as well as I do...

1156
01:22:33,120 --> 01:22:36,691
people will say almost anything
to save their own life.

1157
01:22:36,724 --> 01:22:38,626
Yeah, but her father's real.

1158
01:22:38,660 --> 01:22:39,928
We both know that.

1159
01:22:39,993 --> 01:22:42,129
Amanda, the reality is...

1160
01:22:43,665 --> 01:22:44,666
I'm dying.

1161
01:22:46,634 --> 01:22:47,968
I am dying.

1162
01:22:48,001 --> 01:22:49,470
(SOBBING)

1163
01:22:49,503 --> 01:22:50,772
You have to face that.

1164
01:22:50,805 --> 01:22:52,473
But our work's not gonna end.

1165
01:22:53,775 --> 01:22:57,712
And I'm trust... trusting you...

1166
01:23:01,315 --> 01:23:02,349
to carry on.

1167
01:23:16,363 --> 01:23:18,031
(AMANDA SOBBING)

1168
01:23:33,848 --> 01:23:35,550
JOHN: It's almost morning.

1169
01:23:35,583 --> 01:23:37,552
We have a job to do.

1170
01:23:37,585 --> 01:23:39,353
We're running out of time.

1171
01:23:39,386 --> 01:23:43,423
I want you to go
and free Mr. Sears.

1172
01:23:45,092 --> 01:23:47,060
And see if he'll play
by the rules.

1173
01:23:59,674 --> 01:24:00,708
No.

1174
01:24:00,742 --> 01:24:01,976
No.

1175
01:24:02,010 --> 01:24:04,812
Gabriela, you have to take it.

1176
01:24:05,914 --> 01:24:07,015
No.

1177
01:24:07,047 --> 01:24:09,751
We'll never get
out of here otherwise.

1178
01:24:20,528 --> 01:24:22,462
(WHIRRING)

1179
01:24:25,934 --> 01:24:28,201
GABRIELA: <i>What was that?</i>

1180
01:24:30,137 --> 01:24:31,338
<i>What's that?</i>

1181
01:24:38,245 --> 01:24:39,714
JIGSAW: (ON TAPE)
<i>Hello, Gabriela.</i>

1182
01:24:40,815 --> 01:24:42,050
<i>I want to play a game...</i>

1183
01:24:42,082 --> 01:24:43,585
No, no, stop it!

1184
01:24:43,618 --> 01:24:45,452
Stop it. Stop it...

1185
01:24:47,555 --> 01:24:49,624
I'm afraid that's not
going to work.

1186
01:24:51,191 --> 01:24:53,661
<i>You are going to</i>
<i>have to play the game.</i>

1187
01:25:02,070 --> 01:25:03,805
(WHIMPERING)

1188
01:25:14,649 --> 01:25:17,184
(WHIMPERING)

1189
01:25:22,255 --> 01:25:25,693
No! No, no, no, no, no!

1190
01:25:25,727 --> 01:25:26,894
What the fuck?

1191
01:25:30,197 --> 01:25:31,398
(SCREAMING)

1192
01:25:34,702 --> 01:25:36,771
(CHAINS RATTLING)

1193
01:25:39,907 --> 01:25:41,576
(SCREAMING)

1194
01:25:55,590 --> 01:25:57,257
JOHN: <i>Although</i>
<i>you all pretended</i>

1195
01:25:57,290 --> 01:25:59,794
to cure my cancer,

1196
01:25:59,827 --> 01:26:02,530
I have spent years in treatment.

1197
01:26:02,563 --> 01:26:05,867
<i>Chemotherapy,</i>
<i>immunotherapy, radiation.</i>

1198
01:26:05,900 --> 01:26:10,470
<i>Radiation machines</i>
<i>are not to be trifled with.</i>

1199
01:26:10,504 --> 01:26:13,206
So, follow my instructions
carefully, Gabriela.

1200
01:26:20,148 --> 01:26:21,381
Fuck.

1201
01:26:25,053 --> 01:26:30,357
JOHN: <i>The only way out is</i>
<i>to free your hand and ankle</i>
<i>from the shackles.</i>

1202
01:26:30,992 --> 01:26:33,260
<i>Use the tool above you.</i>

1203
01:26:33,293 --> 01:26:34,929
GABRIELA: (CRYING)
No! No, you can't!

1204
01:26:34,962 --> 01:26:36,664
You can't! Let me out!

1205
01:26:36,698 --> 01:26:38,032
(SCREAMING) Let me out!

1206
01:26:38,066 --> 01:26:42,402
Broken bones heal.
Flesh can be grafted.

1207
01:26:42,436 --> 01:26:46,074
<i>This will not be easy,</i>
<i>but then,</i>

1208
01:26:46,107 --> 01:26:50,044
nothing worth having,
like life, ever is.

1209
01:26:50,078 --> 01:26:51,378
(GABRIELA CRYING)

1210
01:26:52,847 --> 01:26:53,981
(SCREAMING)

1211
01:27:00,121 --> 01:27:01,823
You have to take it, Gabby.

1212
01:27:01,856 --> 01:27:03,958
(GABRIELA GROANING IN PAIN)

1213
01:27:06,293 --> 01:27:07,360
CECILIA: Do it.

1214
01:27:07,394 --> 01:27:08,830
You have to do it, Gabby.

1215
01:27:08,863 --> 01:27:10,865
(TENSE MUSIC PLAYING)

1216
01:27:27,949 --> 01:27:29,249
CECILIA: No, no, no, no, no!

1217
01:27:29,282 --> 01:27:30,484
Start with your foot.

1218
01:27:30,518 --> 01:27:32,285
You'll swing out of the way.

1219
01:27:34,387 --> 01:27:35,823
(BREATHING HEAVILY)

1220
01:27:35,857 --> 01:27:36,858
Okay, Gabby.

1221
01:27:39,994 --> 01:27:41,495
(SCREAMING)

1222
01:27:44,866 --> 01:27:46,934
(MALLET THUDDING)

1223
01:27:52,840 --> 01:27:54,175
(BONE CRACKS)

1224
01:27:54,208 --> 01:27:56,577
(SCREAMING)

1225
01:28:17,297 --> 01:28:19,033
You did it, Gabby.

1226
01:28:19,066 --> 01:28:20,067
(GROANS WEAKLY)

1227
01:28:29,610 --> 01:28:30,611
No.

1228
01:28:32,914 --> 01:28:34,447
No. No.

1229
01:28:37,718 --> 01:28:41,589
No. No, no. No.

1230
01:28:41,622 --> 01:28:44,158
(SOBBING) Stop it. Please.

1231
01:28:44,192 --> 01:28:46,894
Don't stop. Gabby!

1232
01:28:52,033 --> 01:28:54,367
(GRUNTING IN PAIN)

1233
01:28:59,073 --> 01:29:00,842
(GRUNTING)

1234
01:29:16,389 --> 01:29:18,059
(SCREAMS)

1235
01:29:18,759 --> 01:29:20,094
(WHIMPERING)

1236
01:29:28,135 --> 01:29:29,270
Drop her at a hospital.

1237
01:29:29,303 --> 01:29:30,972
Okay, play time's over.

1238
01:29:33,406 --> 01:29:35,408
-Give me the keys.
-(AMANDA GROANS)

1239
01:29:35,442 --> 01:29:37,778
I stated to you very clearly,

1240
01:29:37,812 --> 01:29:40,882
that guns were
against the rules.

1241
01:29:40,915 --> 01:29:42,550
Fuck your rules, John.

1242
01:29:42,583 --> 01:29:44,752
The keys to Cecilia's chains.

1243
01:29:44,785 --> 01:29:48,022
You don't need the keys.
She's not going anywhere.

1244
01:29:48,055 --> 01:29:50,057
(DRAMATIC MUSIC PLAYING)

1245
01:29:58,966 --> 01:29:59,967
Now, move.

1246
01:30:03,304 --> 01:30:04,772
(DOOR OPENS)

1247
01:30:21,421 --> 01:30:23,557
Come on. Move.

1248
01:30:25,092 --> 01:30:27,128
(GROANING)

1249
01:30:29,630 --> 01:30:31,198
CECILIA: I thought
you forgot about me.

1250
01:30:32,400 --> 01:30:33,466
Not a chance.

1251
01:30:33,500 --> 01:30:35,202
You know I'd die for you, baby.

1252
01:30:41,409 --> 01:30:42,743
Unlock her.

1253
01:30:43,978 --> 01:30:44,979
Now!

1254
01:30:59,393 --> 01:31:00,628
(GRUNTS)

1255
01:31:03,631 --> 01:31:07,168
I've been wanting to do that
since the moment I met you.

1256
01:31:12,807 --> 01:31:15,242
Come on, old man.
Lock yourself in.

1257
01:31:25,519 --> 01:31:26,821
Come on, move!

1258
01:31:33,294 --> 01:31:34,462
(CHAINS RATTLING)

1259
01:32:00,621 --> 01:32:01,956
(LOCK CLICKS IN)

1260
01:32:03,824 --> 01:32:04,992
New game.

1261
01:32:05,026 --> 01:32:08,929
It's called we live,
you die, fuck you.

1262
01:32:08,963 --> 01:32:10,131
Simple enough?

1263
01:32:10,164 --> 01:32:12,500
AMANDA: I told you
Parker would break the rules.

1264
01:32:12,533 --> 01:32:14,301
You failed your test, asshole.

1265
01:32:14,335 --> 01:32:15,369
(LAUGHS)

1266
01:32:15,403 --> 01:32:17,405
We need to get her
to a hospital.

1267
01:32:17,438 --> 01:32:19,373
She won her game

1268
01:32:19,407 --> 01:32:21,208
and she deserves to live.

1269
01:32:21,242 --> 01:32:22,877
Oh, does she now?

1270
01:32:23,811 --> 01:32:26,247
Her injuries need
medical treatment.

1271
01:32:27,314 --> 01:32:28,649
Do they?

1272
01:32:33,020 --> 01:32:34,688
(GASPING)

1273
01:32:34,722 --> 01:32:36,557
Don't even think about it!

1274
01:32:38,092 --> 01:32:39,493
AMANDA: No, no, no, no.

1275
01:32:39,528 --> 01:32:42,396
No, no, no, no, no!

1276
01:32:42,430 --> 01:32:44,031
-(NECK SNAPS)
-(GASPS)

1277
01:32:44,065 --> 01:32:45,332
(AMANDA SCREAMS)

1278
01:32:45,366 --> 01:32:47,768
(SCREAMING) You sick bitch!

1279
01:32:49,036 --> 01:32:51,272
(SCREAMS IN ANGUISH)

1280
01:32:51,305 --> 01:32:55,709
Unfortunately, I don't think
she's gonna make it.

1281
01:32:56,577 --> 01:32:58,446
(SOBBING)

1282
01:32:58,479 --> 01:32:59,680
Parker.

1283
01:33:02,283 --> 01:33:03,284
Give me the keys.

1284
01:33:10,491 --> 01:33:12,326
(AMANDA SCREAMS)

1285
01:33:14,395 --> 01:33:15,663
Lock yourself in.

1286
01:33:24,638 --> 01:33:25,840
(LOCK CLICKING)

1287
01:33:38,085 --> 01:33:40,287
(BREATHING HEAVILY)

1288
01:33:48,362 --> 01:33:49,797
CECILIA: So, tell me, John.

1289
01:33:49,830 --> 01:33:53,200
You've been doing this for a
very long time, haven't you?

1290
01:33:53,234 --> 01:33:54,368
How did I stop you?

1291
01:33:55,503 --> 01:33:57,539
Am I just that good?

1292
01:33:57,572 --> 01:34:00,007
Don't flatter yourself.

1293
01:34:00,040 --> 01:34:02,276
I just had a lapse in judgement.

1294
01:34:02,309 --> 01:34:04,178
-That's all.
-Yeah, I agree.

1295
01:34:04,211 --> 01:34:06,515
For a guy as smart
as you are, John,

1296
01:34:06,548 --> 01:34:09,884
you kind of overplayed
your hand here,
wouldn't you say?

1297
01:34:09,917 --> 01:34:11,152
You don't give a shit

1298
01:34:11,185 --> 01:34:13,287
that all your friends are dead
because of you?

1299
01:34:13,320 --> 01:34:14,421
Friends?

1300
01:34:16,223 --> 01:34:17,691
Not friends.

1301
01:34:17,725 --> 01:34:19,860
They were loose ends,
sweetheart.

1302
01:34:19,894 --> 01:34:22,062
Nothing but loose ends.

1303
01:34:22,096 --> 01:34:25,833
Do you want to know
what I thought when
I watched them each die?

1304
01:34:26,867 --> 01:34:29,638
One less person
to split the money with.

1305
01:34:29,670 --> 01:34:31,540
So, thank you.

1306
01:34:31,573 --> 01:34:32,940
You did me a favor.

1307
01:34:32,973 --> 01:34:35,376
You're gonna have to get
the money back from me,

1308
01:34:36,310 --> 01:34:38,513
before you two can split it.

1309
01:34:38,547 --> 01:34:40,347
PARKER: I think
we'll get the money back.

1310
01:34:40,381 --> 01:34:41,782
It's upstairs.

1311
01:34:41,815 --> 01:34:44,351
You know she's eventually
gonna kill you, too, right?

1312
01:34:44,385 --> 01:34:45,686
Fuck off, Amanda.

1313
01:34:45,719 --> 01:34:47,321
JOHN: Amanda's right.

1314
01:34:47,354 --> 01:34:48,989
She's gonna burn you.

1315
01:34:49,023 --> 01:34:50,791
You just can't see it yet.

1316
01:34:50,824 --> 01:34:52,259
CECILIA: God...

1317
01:34:52,293 --> 01:34:54,929
Is that really
all you've got left, John?

1318
01:34:54,962 --> 01:34:57,765
When I realized
who you really were...

1319
01:34:57,798 --> 01:34:59,400
Jig-fucking-saw...

1320
01:35:01,335 --> 01:35:02,770
I got a bit worried.

1321
01:35:03,771 --> 01:35:05,439
God's honest.

1322
01:35:05,472 --> 01:35:07,942
And now, the great John Kramer

1323
01:35:07,975 --> 01:35:10,411
is gonna die
in one of his own traps.

1324
01:35:10,444 --> 01:35:13,080
There's some wicked irony.

1325
01:35:13,113 --> 01:35:16,450
And the crazy thing is,
that you could have
just walked away.

1326
01:35:17,885 --> 01:35:21,355
Acknowledged that you
got beat, got conned.

1327
01:35:22,624 --> 01:35:23,824
But, no...

1328
01:35:25,560 --> 01:35:28,095
You just had to come back,
didn't you?

1329
01:35:30,431 --> 01:35:33,334
Why don't we put this bitch
on the other side of that thing

1330
01:35:33,367 --> 01:35:34,969
and press play?

1331
01:35:36,337 --> 01:35:38,105
(THUDDING ON WALL)

1332
01:35:55,889 --> 01:35:59,728
You know, this fucking asshole
is dead in two months,

1333
01:35:59,760 --> 01:36:03,397
but I want him to suffer
like he made me suffer.

1334
01:36:03,430 --> 01:36:07,501
I want his last memory to be
watching someone innocent die.

1335
01:36:07,535 --> 01:36:09,571
If you think I'm innocent...

1336
01:36:09,604 --> 01:36:10,904
You?

1337
01:36:11,640 --> 01:36:12,741
Not for a second.

1338
01:36:12,773 --> 01:36:14,375
(THUDDING CONTINUES)

1339
01:36:16,810 --> 01:36:18,445
But I think I hear an answer.

1340
01:36:24,318 --> 01:36:25,386
(DOOR OPENS)

1341

00:42:14,407 --> 00:42:19,447

572
00:42:19,537 --> 00:42:23,246
Survival is simple,

573

Leaving you free

577

Live or die, make your choice.

Word on the street is that mother...
Motherfucker od'd.

729
00:51:51,525 --> 00:51:53,561
That's what I'm here for.

Look, some guy came to a meeting drunk

733

735

He let the whole thing slide

736

Loyalty.

737

Loyalty.

738

739

God loves you, Zeke.

Can't believe that guy used to be a cop.

742

743

Fair point.

746

Maybe it's a good thing

Yeah, dad, I'm at your apartment.

00:53:19,029 --> 00:53:22,362
Schenk; It's 9:00 A.M.,

Hey! Hey! Hey!

Get him out of here.

Take him to holding.

I'm sorry, banks, he blew right past me.

No way, Zeke, that one is not the same.

Everybody out! Everybody out!

Everybody, go!

Is that fucking skin?

769

"Am I getting under your skin,

Careful, while you're looking

771

I'll take your head."

772

"I'll take your head..."

773
00:54:40,277 --> 00:54:43,690
"Am I getting under your skin...

774
00:54:43,781 --> 00:54:45,066
Am I getting under your skin...

Am I getting under your skin...?"

Family. This is my wife, Emma,

786

Oh, my god.

Anything?

Your dad's the reason I wanted

"Am I getting under your skin,

I was writing a ticket

00:58:52,237 --> 00:58:53,977
I fought him off
the best I could and he...

822
00:58:54,072 --> 00:58:55,072
He took off running.

823
00:58:55,157 --> 00:58:58,194
Is there any reason
he would have to attack you?

824
00:58:58,285 --> 00:59:01,618
No. He just wanted to mess with the cops.

825
00:59:01,705 --> 00:59:05,664
"Careful, while you're looking
for more bodies to drop,

826
00:59:05,751 --> 00:59:07,082
I'll take your head."

827
00:59:07,169 --> 00:59:09,501
Angie, you're the head of the department.

828
00:59:09,588 --> 00:59:10,748
Angie...

829
00:59:10,839 --> 00:59:12,420
Fuck!

830
00:59:12,507 --> 00:59:14,043
Angie! Pick up!

831
00:59:21,725 --> 00:59:23,386
Hey, you've reached captain Angie garza,

832
00:59:23,477 --> 00:59:24,957
leave a message aft the tone. Thanks.

833
00:59:30,776 --> 00:59:34,689
Angie, get to the bullpen!
He's coming for you!

834
00:59:42,204 --> 00:59:44,115
Fuck. Fuck, fuck, fuck.

835
00:59:46,917 --> 00:59:47,952
Shit!

836
00:59:49,002 --> 00:59:51,835
Hey! Hey! Hey!

837
01:00:02,516 --> 01:00:05,974
Hello? Hello! Shit!

838
01:01:05,787 --> 01:01:09,738
Help!

839
01:01:12,752 --> 01:01:14,117
Hello, captain garza.

840
01:01:14,212 --> 01:01:15,827
I want to play a game.

841
01:01:15,922 --> 01:01:18,379
You have covered up corruption
in your department,

842
01:01:18,466 --> 01:01:21,082
never sticking your neck out
for the innocent.

843
01:01:21,178 --> 01:01:23,510
Now, the cover-up will be on you.

844
01:01:23,597 --> 01:01:28,557
In a few seconds, boiling hot wax
will be coming out of the pipe above you.

845
01:01:28,643 --> 01:01:31,680
The only way to stop yourself
from being suffocated

846
01:01:31,771 --> 01:01:35,605
is to sever your spinal cord
with the blade beneath your neck,

847
01:01:35,692 --> 01:01:37,228
which will stop the wax.

848
01:01:37,319 --> 01:01:38,684
You cannot walk away,

849
01:01:38,778 --> 01:01:40,359
but you can survive.

850
01:01:40,447 --> 01:01:42,278
Live or die, make your choice.

851
01:01:43,617 --> 01:01:45,528
Fuck you!

852
01:01:53,960 --> 01:01:57,373
Angie! Angie!

853
01:01:57,464 --> 01:01:59,375
Get the fuck out of the way!

854
01:02:15,732 --> 01:02:17,168
How come no one is answering the phone?

855
01:02:17,192 --> 01:02:19,232
An officer was attacked,
it's fucking chaos in here.

856
01:02:19,277 --> 01:02:22,314
Angie! Angie!

857
01:02:26,409 --> 01:02:27,409
Angie?

858
01:02:28,286 --> 01:02:30,777
- Zeke, what's going on?
- He's got her!

859
01:02:30,872 --> 01:02:31,987
Who's got her?

860
01:02:32,082 --> 01:02:33,993
The killer has Angie!

861
01:02:34,084 --> 01:02:36,938
I guess you didn't hear, the killer
just attacked a cop at 3rd and beaman.

862
01:02:36,962 --> 01:02:40,420
That was just a diversion
to get us out of the precinct.

863
01:02:40,507 --> 01:02:42,122
She's down in the fucking basement!

864
01:02:52,852 --> 01:02:53,887
Did you find Angie?

865
01:02:53,979 --> 01:02:56,015
In the basement, in the basement!

866
01:02:56,106 --> 01:02:59,348
Captain Angie garza, call the front desk.

867
01:03:14,916 --> 01:03:15,916
Open it!

868
01:03:16,793 --> 01:03:18,124
Hurry up!

869
01:03:19,129 --> 01:03:20,494
Angie!

870
01:03:21,840 --> 01:03:22,920
Open it!

871
01:03:23,008 --> 01:03:24,008
Okay.

872
01:03:28,555 --> 01:03:29,555
Shit!

873
01:03:31,641 --> 01:03:35,259
It's okay, it's okay.
It's gonna be fine.

874
01:03:35,353 --> 01:03:36,353
Oh, my god.

875
01:03:40,984 --> 01:03:42,440
It's okay.

876
01:03:43,486 --> 01:03:44,486
It's okay... oh...

877
01:04:43,338 --> 01:04:44,578
I ock it down.

878
01:04:44,672 --> 01:04:46,287
You understand me? Lock it down.

879
01:04:46,383 --> 01:04:48,544
Nobody gets out of this precinct.

880
01:04:48,635 --> 01:04:52,503
I need all the footage from the cameras
in the evidence room.

881
01:04:53,431 --> 01:04:55,843
Okay, here...
Here's when the call came in,

882
01:04:55,934 --> 01:04:58,391
but then there's nothing
until you come in.

883
01:04:58,478 --> 01:05:03,643
You see right there,
it jumps from 13:11 to 13:24. Glitch?

884
01:05:03,733 --> 01:05:05,223
No, there's no glitch,

885
01:05:05,318 --> 01:05:07,463
because look, on the first frame,
the safe door is open,

886
01:05:07,487 --> 01:05:08,818
but on the next, it's shut.

887
01:05:08,905 --> 01:05:10,190
There's 13 minutes missing.

888
01:05:10,281 --> 01:05:13,318
Access to this footage,
is that through the computer system?

889
01:05:13,410 --> 01:05:15,054
Yeah, we just need
a badge number and a password.

890
01:05:15,078 --> 01:05:16,739
I can't tell you who deleted the video,

891
01:05:16,830 --> 01:05:19,697
but I can access who logged into
the server over the past day.

892
01:05:20,333 --> 01:05:23,825
O'brien, tupper, nicholazi...

893
01:05:23,920 --> 01:05:27,287
Wait, who's badge number 2-1-3?

894
01:05:27,382 --> 01:05:29,168
Pete dunleavy, my old partner.

895
01:05:29,259 --> 01:05:31,250
Dunleavy? He shouldn't have access.

896
01:05:31,344 --> 01:05:33,505
How long's it been
since he was even on the job?

897
01:05:34,806 --> 01:05:35,806
Where you going?

898
01:05:35,890 --> 01:05:37,300
To pay Pete a visit.

899
01:05:37,392 --> 01:05:39,348
Zeke, he's not the only one!

900
01:05:39,811 --> 01:05:40,971
Your father had access, too.

901
01:05:41,062 --> 01:05:42,848
The location of schenk's body,

902
01:05:42,939 --> 01:05:44,959
you said it was where
your father took you as a kid.

903
01:05:44,983 --> 01:05:47,224
When was the last time
you saw your father?

904
01:05:49,571 --> 01:05:51,311
- This morning.
- Bullshit.

905
01:05:52,782 --> 01:05:53,988
Motherfucker!

906
01:05:54,075 --> 01:05:55,110
What the fuck, Zeke?

907
01:05:55,201 --> 01:05:56,691
Fuck you, man!

908
01:05:56,786 --> 01:05:58,822
- Fuck you!
- Get the fuck out of here!

909
01:05:58,913 --> 01:06:01,074
- Get him out of here!
- Fuck you! You're too close!

910
01:06:02,292 --> 01:06:03,873
You're too close to this thing, Zeke.

911
01:06:16,264 --> 01:06:17,549
Petel

912
01:06:18,850 --> 01:06:19,850
petel

913
01:06:21,102 --> 01:06:22,102
petel

914
01:06:29,194 --> 01:06:30,684
[Eave a message.

915
01:06:31,404 --> 01:06:36,819
Dad, I've called you three times,
please call me back!

916
01:06:36,910 --> 01:06:40,402
People are asking questions,
and I'm sick of making excuses.

917
01:06:40,497 --> 01:06:42,829
You got something to tell me? Fuck!

918
01:07:49,524 --> 01:07:51,389
You wanna play games, motherfucker?

919
01:07:52,652 --> 01:07:54,608
All right, I'll play.

920
01:09:35,505 --> 01:09:36,505
You okay?

921
01:09:39,801 --> 01:09:40,916
Hey!

922
01:09:48,059 --> 01:09:49,424
Help!

923
01:11:25,907 --> 01:11:26,907
Pete?

924
01:11:28,576 --> 01:11:30,032
Pete, wake up.

925
01:11:30,119 --> 01:11:31,234
Petel

926
01:11:35,500 --> 01:11:38,412
what? Zeke? Fuck.

927
01:11:39,587 --> 01:11:41,077
Get me the fuck down, Zeke.

928
01:11:41,631 --> 01:11:42,666
Come on!

929
01:11:42,757 --> 01:11:44,122
You hacked the computer.

930
01:11:45,635 --> 01:11:47,876
You erased the surveillance footage.

931
01:11:47,970 --> 01:11:49,573
I don't know what the fuck
you're talking about, Zeke.

932
01:11:49,597 --> 01:11:51,337
- Did you kill Angie?
- What?

933
01:11:51,432 --> 01:11:53,718
- Did you kill boz?
- What the fuck are you talking about?

934
01:11:53,810 --> 01:11:57,052
- Did you kill boz?
- Boz? Fuck...

935
01:11:57,146 --> 01:11:59,637
What the fuck is with you, Zeke?
Get me the fuck out of here!

936
01:11:59,732 --> 01:12:02,269
Is this some sick fucking revenge, Zeke?

937
01:12:02,360 --> 01:12:04,351
Putting me in jail isn't enough, huh?

938
01:12:04,445 --> 01:12:05,776
Get me the fuck out of here!

939
01:12:15,414 --> 01:12:17,245
Hello, detective banks.

940
01:12:17,333 --> 01:12:19,244
I want to play a game.

941
01:12:19,335 --> 01:12:22,247
When Peter dunleavy
murdered an innocent man,

942
01:12:22,338 --> 01:12:24,954
your career was shattered like glass.

943
01:12:25,049 --> 01:12:29,713
Can you stand on the sidelines
while justice is finally served?

944
01:12:29,804 --> 01:12:31,544
There is a way to save him,

945
01:12:31,639 --> 01:12:35,552
or you can keep him locked up
and throw away the key.

946
01:12:35,643 --> 01:12:37,474
The decision is yours.

947
01:12:37,562 --> 01:12:39,894
"Throw away the key," what the fuck?

948
01:12:39,981 --> 01:12:41,061
Huh?

949
01:12:45,403 --> 01:12:46,438
Fuck.

950
01:12:47,655 --> 01:12:48,690
Eke.

951
01:12:53,619 --> 01:12:55,450
Get me the fuck out of this thing.

952
01:12:57,290 --> 01:12:58,450
Eke.

953
01:12:59,625 --> 01:13:02,082
Oh, shit.

954
01:13:07,133 --> 01:13:08,168
Come on, Zeke.

955
01:13:09,969 --> 01:13:11,329
Get me the fuck out of here, Zeke!

956
01:13:18,561 --> 01:13:19,641
Shit!

957
01:13:25,735 --> 01:13:27,191
Zeke! Help me!

958
01:13:32,909 --> 01:13:33,909
/eke?

959
01:13:35,828 --> 01:13:37,318
Get me out, come on, man.

960
01:13:57,391 --> 01:13:58,391
/ekel

961
01:14:03,356 --> 01:14:05,563
/ekel

962
01:14:05,650 --> 01:14:07,811
or you can keep him locked up

963
01:14:07,902 --> 01:14:09,563
and throw away the key.

964
01:14:10,613 --> 01:14:11,613
Petel

965
01:14:28,923 --> 01:14:29,923
I'm coming, Pete!

966
01:14:45,272 --> 01:14:46,272
Shit.

967
01:14:47,483 --> 01:14:49,599
Fuck. I got you, I got you.

968
01:14:53,739 --> 01:14:54,739
Come on, Pete.

969
01:15:00,371 --> 01:15:01,406
Petel

970
01:15:02,164 --> 01:15:03,199
petel

971
01:16:10,608 --> 01:16:13,270
You disloyal piece of shit.

972
01:16:17,573 --> 01:16:21,031
I've been loyal to you
since the first day we met.

973
01:16:22,161 --> 01:16:23,526
Fifteen years ago.

974
01:16:24,080 --> 01:16:26,696
The day your partner killed my father.

975
01:16:29,335 --> 01:16:34,420
So, Charlie, you saw this cop
throw the victim off a rooftop,

976
01:16:34,507 --> 01:16:36,714
and you can positively ID this cop?

977
01:16:36,801 --> 01:16:38,962
I'll testify, officer dunleavy.

978
01:16:39,053 --> 01:16:40,088
I'll do it.

979
01:16:49,396 --> 01:16:52,479
Pete! Pete!
What happened, what happened?

980
01:16:53,067 --> 01:16:54,067
He pulled a gun on me.

981
01:16:54,110 --> 01:16:55,975
The witness pulled a gun on you?

982
01:17:00,449 --> 01:17:01,655
Shh.

983
01:17:01,742 --> 01:17:03,778
Pete killed Charlie emmerson.

984
01:17:03,869 --> 01:17:05,825
What? You thought I'd use my real name?

985
01:17:05,913 --> 01:17:09,497
Do you have any idea how hard it was
to get placed in this department,

986
01:17:09,583 --> 01:17:11,869
to get assigned to be your partner?

987
01:17:15,047 --> 01:17:17,834
What about your family,
what about your son?

988
01:17:17,925 --> 01:17:19,506
This is my son, Charlie.

989
01:17:22,346 --> 01:17:23,381
I don't have a son.

990
01:17:25,558 --> 01:17:26,558
Charlie's sleeping...

991
01:17:27,017 --> 01:17:28,598
Was sleeping.

992
01:17:28,686 --> 01:17:31,428
After Benny wrights led boz
down the subway tunnels...

993
01:17:34,608 --> 01:17:36,314
I tattooed my dad's name on his arm.

994
01:17:39,155 --> 01:17:40,645
Where is my father?

995
01:17:40,739 --> 01:17:42,104
You'll see him soon.

996
01:17:42,199 --> 01:17:43,939
Where the fuck is my father?

997
01:17:44,034 --> 01:17:46,821
I didn't even ask him
to come down here. You did.

998
01:17:46,912 --> 01:17:48,994
- Let me borrow your phone, shut up.
- Okay.

999
01:17:49,081 --> 01:17:50,537
Thank you.

1000
01:17:50,624 --> 01:17:52,706
Don't drain my battery
watching twilight.

1001
01:18:12,730 --> 01:18:14,686
Where is he?

1002
01:18:14,773 --> 01:18:17,310
- Don't you want to hear my offer?
- Do I have a choice?

1003
01:18:18,402 --> 01:18:19,437
I want to be partners.

1004
01:18:20,946 --> 01:18:23,938
You took a stand, Zeke,
against a dirty cop,

1005
01:18:24,033 --> 01:18:25,113
and what did it get you?

1006
01:18:27,536 --> 01:18:31,199
A lifetime of watching your back,
working alone.

1007
01:18:31,290 --> 01:18:34,373
Getting the call for every homeless bum
who turns up dead.

1008
01:18:34,460 --> 01:18:36,062
I mean, let's be real,
some of these motherfuckers

1009
01:18:36,086 --> 01:18:37,701
are straight up evil.

1010
01:18:37,796 --> 01:18:39,627
Fitch not backing you up...

1011
01:18:39,715 --> 01:18:40,750
Fuck him.

1012
01:18:42,468 --> 01:18:43,753
He won't repeat that mistake.

1013
01:18:46,180 --> 01:18:48,421
And boz, always lying under oath...

1014
01:18:50,226 --> 01:18:52,137
But you, you're different.

1015
01:18:52,228 --> 01:18:53,889
You're Metro's finest.

1016
01:18:55,022 --> 01:18:56,887
That's why I want to team up
with you on this.

1017
01:18:56,982 --> 01:18:59,564
You find the dirty cops,
and I'll take care of the rest.

1018
01:19:00,402 --> 01:19:03,064
You want me to help you kill cops?

1019
01:19:03,155 --> 01:19:05,942
No, fuck no. Just the bad ones.

1020
01:19:06,659 --> 01:19:09,446
John Kramer was right, the spiral.

1021
01:19:10,162 --> 01:19:14,326
A symbol of change, evolution, progress.

1022
01:19:14,416 --> 01:19:18,455
But why limit that to an individual
when you can apply it to a whole system?

1023
01:19:18,545 --> 01:19:20,786
You got shot for doing the right thing.

1024
01:19:20,881 --> 01:19:22,291
Let's face it, these cops?

1025
01:19:22,383 --> 01:19:23,735
They're not going to clean up
on their own.

1026
01:19:23,759 --> 01:19:28,048
But we take a tongue here,
a few bones there, they'll come around.

1027
01:19:28,764 --> 01:19:31,756
We're going to fix
a broken department. Okay?

1028
01:19:31,850 --> 01:19:33,181
You and me.

1029
01:19:33,269 --> 01:19:34,269
Okay.

1030
01:19:35,646 --> 01:19:36,646
Okay.

1031
01:19:37,439 --> 01:19:38,474
I et's do it.

1032
01:19:38,565 --> 01:19:41,932
I want to trust you. I do.

1033
01:19:42,027 --> 01:19:44,894
I'm in. But my dad goes free.

1034
01:19:50,411 --> 01:19:52,367
One second.

1035
01:19:52,454 --> 01:19:54,740
911, please state your emergency.

1036
01:19:54,832 --> 01:19:57,824
Hello, I'm at the old soap factory
on madigan Lane.

1037
01:19:57,918 --> 01:20:01,502
There's a crazy guy with a gun
he's firing it everywhere. Please hurry!

1038
01:20:01,588 --> 01:20:03,169
What the fuck was that?

1039
01:20:03,257 --> 01:20:05,043
You better hurry, Zeke,
SWAT's on the way.

1040
01:20:05,134 --> 01:20:07,591
Look, I want to believe you, I do.

1041
01:20:10,139 --> 01:20:11,174
I want to trust you.

1042
01:20:12,391 --> 01:20:15,007
Take this, you'll need it. Come on.

1043
01:20:16,937 --> 01:20:18,177
Let's go see your dad.

1044
01:20:26,864 --> 01:20:28,064
It's time for your final test.

1045
01:20:40,252 --> 01:20:41,252
Dad.

1046
01:20:41,628 --> 01:20:42,663
Ezekiel.

1047
01:20:42,755 --> 01:20:44,086
Oh, shit! Get him down!

1048
01:20:49,428 --> 01:20:50,668
Oh, shit.

1049
01:20:53,891 --> 01:20:54,971
I got you, dad.

1050
01:20:55,059 --> 01:20:56,515
Zeke. Help me, son.

1051
01:21:00,064 --> 01:21:01,474
Don't worry, don't worry.

1052
01:21:01,565 --> 01:21:04,477
I'm not going to let you die.
I will get you down.

1053
01:21:08,864 --> 01:21:09,899
All right, just hold on.

1054
01:21:09,990 --> 01:21:12,026
Shoot this motherfucker right now.

1055
01:21:13,744 --> 01:21:16,486
Get him down! Get him down now!

1056
01:21:17,748 --> 01:21:19,704
I thought we were partners.

1057
01:21:19,792 --> 01:21:21,578
You going to shoot me, Zeke?

1058
01:21:21,668 --> 01:21:23,454
With your one bullet?

1059
01:21:23,545 --> 01:21:25,831
It's a bad idea. It kills your dad.

1060
01:21:28,509 --> 01:21:30,045
He took a shot at me, by the way.

1061
01:21:30,886 --> 01:21:33,502
Missed. I wasted four.

1062
01:21:33,597 --> 01:21:35,258
That means you got one shot left, Zeke.

1063
01:21:37,101 --> 01:21:41,185
All right, cops are here.
That gives us four minutes.

1064
01:21:41,271 --> 01:21:43,831
Do you know there's 1.5 gallons of blood
in the human body, Zeke?

1065
01:21:48,153 --> 01:21:50,269
At the rate your old man is bleeding out,

1066
01:21:50,364 --> 01:21:53,231
in just three minutes,
those jars will be full

1067
01:21:53,325 --> 01:21:55,031
and your dad will be dead.

1068
01:21:56,203 --> 01:21:57,693
The only thing that can set him free

1069
01:21:57,788 --> 01:22:01,121
is the bullet in your gun
fired at that target.

1070
01:22:01,625 --> 01:22:03,866
Either way, I've got
a foolproof way out of here.

1071
01:22:05,712 --> 01:22:06,712
You're not Jigsaw.

1072
01:22:07,464 --> 01:22:08,464
That's the game.

1073
01:22:09,716 --> 01:22:12,298
Shoot me and you both lose.

1074
01:22:12,386 --> 01:22:14,468
Shoot the target and we both win.

1075
01:22:15,347 --> 01:22:18,839
- You want to play?
- I'm dying, Zeke, end it now.

1076
01:22:20,102 --> 01:22:21,558
We're in maintenance corridor.

1077
01:22:21,645 --> 01:22:23,601
Roger that.
I just breached southwest entrance.

1078
01:22:25,065 --> 01:22:26,225
Going through the south door.

1079
01:22:28,527 --> 01:22:30,267
Nothing here. Keep moving.

1080
01:22:30,362 --> 01:22:31,522
I need you all in.

1081
01:22:31,613 --> 01:22:35,276
Dunleavy ruined both our lives,
and you tried to help that piece of shit?

1082
01:22:35,367 --> 01:22:37,528
- Zeke!
- Pete!

1083
01:22:37,619 --> 01:22:39,405
You failed that test.

1084
01:22:39,496 --> 01:22:41,376
Now I need you to choose
who you're really with.

1085
01:22:41,748 --> 01:22:45,491
The man who corrupted the force,
or the one who's trying to save it.

1086
01:22:45,586 --> 01:22:46,706
You want to tell him, chief?

1087
01:22:49,047 --> 01:22:50,412
Tell me what?

1088
01:22:50,507 --> 01:22:53,749
Tell him about all the fucking shit
you did under article 8.

1089
01:22:54,511 --> 01:22:56,001
What's he talking about?

1090
01:22:56,096 --> 01:22:58,052
- Time's running out.
- What's he talking about?

1091
01:22:58,140 --> 01:23:01,223
Citizens were dying.

1092
01:23:01,310 --> 01:23:04,973
We did what we had to
to clean up the streets.

1093
01:23:05,063 --> 01:23:06,803
It was crazy back then, right?

1094
01:23:06,899 --> 01:23:10,107
We were working under article 8,
we were out of control.

1095
01:23:12,237 --> 01:23:14,273
Murder rate went way down.

1096
01:23:14,865 --> 01:23:16,321
That's fucking bullshit.

1097
01:23:16,408 --> 01:23:18,069
People felt safe again.

1098
01:23:18,160 --> 01:23:20,651
The streets got cleaner
because the cops got dirtier.

1099
01:23:20,746 --> 01:23:22,348
Your dad oversaw the whole thing,
by the way.

1100
01:23:22,372 --> 01:23:25,409
Innocent people getting shot,
all in the name of justice.

1101
01:23:25,501 --> 01:23:28,709
Article 8 was one of the most corrupt
police policies in history,

1102
01:23:28,795 --> 01:23:30,440
and guess who was
your dad's right-hand man?

1103
01:23:30,464 --> 01:23:32,250
Sorry, or should I say woman,
the whole time?

1104
01:23:32,341 --> 01:23:35,048
We'll handle it. We always do, huh?

1105
01:23:35,135 --> 01:23:37,592
- Angie?
- Angie!

1106
01:23:37,679 --> 01:23:38,839
It was Angie.

1107
01:23:38,931 --> 01:23:40,467
I mean, not a massive surprise.

1108
01:23:40,557 --> 01:23:42,343
You think it was her stellar reputation

1109
01:23:42,434 --> 01:23:44,265
that got her a precinct at age 357
come on.

1110
01:23:44,353 --> 01:23:47,311
Shoot this piece of shit, Ezekiel. Now.

1111
01:23:47,397 --> 01:23:49,125
Yeah, that's right,
because that's what cops do.

1112
01:23:49,149 --> 01:23:50,469
Shoot first, ask questions later.

1113
01:23:53,820 --> 01:23:56,687
You watched my father die
and I'm trying to save yours.

1114
01:23:56,782 --> 01:23:59,899
If we're going to trust each other,
I need you to do this.

1115
01:24:01,370 --> 01:24:02,405
Ezekiel...

1116
01:24:02,496 --> 01:24:06,364
You've always done the right thing,
do it now.

1117
01:24:06,959 --> 01:24:08,620
This piece of shit is killing cops.

1118
01:24:10,379 --> 01:24:15,123
You still need to decide,
you can shoot me, or...

1119
01:24:15,551 --> 01:24:16,916
Or you can save your dad.

1120
01:24:18,804 --> 01:24:19,964
Clock's ticking, man.

1121
01:24:20,055 --> 01:24:21,340
Think fast.

1122
01:24:22,516 --> 01:24:23,926
Cavalry's coming.

1123
01:24:24,017 --> 01:24:26,303
But not in time to do
any favors for your old man.

1124
01:24:26,395 --> 01:24:27,555
Only you can do that.

1125
01:24:35,946 --> 01:24:38,358
Dad? Dad? Oh, my god.

1126
01:24:38,448 --> 01:24:39,448
Shots fired!

1127
01:24:49,209 --> 01:24:50,494
Eke... Zeke.

1128
01:24:51,753 --> 01:24:52,753
It's going to be okay.

1129
01:24:52,838 --> 01:24:56,001
He's getting away.

1130
01:24:56,091 --> 01:24:58,082
Don't let him get away.

1131
01:24:58,719 --> 01:25:00,801
Go... go!

1132
01:25:18,405 --> 01:25:20,862
Stop. Don't come in.

1133
01:25:20,949 --> 01:25:22,029
Don't come in.

1134
01:25:39,801 --> 01:25:42,793
Whoever did this has another motive,
something personal.

1135
01:25:42,888 --> 01:25:44,094
Whoever did this...

1136
01:25:46,850 --> 01:25:49,182
They're pulling all the strings.

1137
01:25:51,647 --> 01:25:53,729
Your dad is the reason for all of this.

1138
01:25:53,815 --> 01:25:55,585
He's why I wanted to do this
in the first place.

1139
01:25:55,609 --> 01:25:57,769
I've been dreaming about this
since I was 12 years old.

1140
01:26:04,451 --> 01:26:06,316
What the fuck's going on?

1141
01:26:10,332 --> 01:26:12,163
Go, go, go!

1142
01:26:13,085 --> 01:26:15,622
- Get down! Get down now!
- Let me see your hands!

1143
01:26:16,546 --> 01:26:17,661
No! No, no, stop!

1144
01:26:17,756 --> 01:26:18,962
God!

1145
01:26:19,049 --> 01:26:20,539
- Freeze!
- No, no!

1146
01:26:24,054 --> 01:26:24,964
Nol

1147
01:26:25,055 --> 01:26:26,215
put it down!

1148
01:26:27,599 --> 01:26:29,009
Lower your weapon!

1149
01:26:29,101 --> 01:26:30,101
Fire!

1150
01:26:52,999 --> 01:26:55,911
Nol

1151
01:26:56,305 --> 01:27:56,220
Ask free legal questions on
ClearwayLaw.com
